name: credit-friend
description: AI-powered SaaS tool for credit analysis in financial companies

scripts.server: bash -lc 'if [ -d backend ] && [ -f backend/package.json ]; then cd backend && npm run dev; else echo "[server] backend directory or package.json not found; skipping."; fi'
scripts.client: bash -lc 'if [ -d frontend ] && [ -f frontend/package.json ]; then cd frontend && npm start; else echo "[client] frontend directory or package.json not found; skipping."; fi'
scripts.build: bash -lc 'if [ -d frontend ] && [ -f frontend/package.json ]; then cd frontend && npm run build; else echo "[build] frontend directory or package.json not found; skipping build."; fi'
scripts.install-all: bash -lc 'npm install; if [ -d backend ] && [ -f backend/package.json ]; then (cd backend && npm install); else echo "[install-all] backend missing; skipping."; fi; if [ -d frontend ] && [ -f frontend/package.json ]; then (cd frontend && npm install); else echo "[install-all] frontend missing; skipping."; fi'
scripts.test:backend: bash -lc 'if [ -d backend ] && [ -f backend/package.json ]; then cd backend && npm test; else echo "[test:backend] backend missing; skipping."; fi'
scripts.test:frontend: bash -lc 'if [ -d frontend ] && [ -f frontend/package.json ]; then cd frontend && npm test; else echo "[test:frontend] frontend missing; skipping."; fi'
scripts.test:e2e: echo "E2E tests are not configured in this MVP." && exit 0

author: Credit Friend Team
